integrity: The matrix is reconstructed from the source definition on every symmetric binary matrix, and exact Gaussian elimination over \(\mathbb F_2\) exhausts all \(1024\) and \(32768\) rows for \(m=4,5\). Deterministic pivot-basis hashes make the finite replay stable.
scientific_limitations: The result is finite: it determines the full-parity binary ranks only through \(m=5\), with the substantive open cases \(m=4,5\). It does not settle the asymptotic unit-rate question or nonlinear storage capacity.
title: Exact storage rates at \(m=4,5\) in the quadratic Reed--Muller family
